<ic>Resupply the Red Wind Corsairs<br>Resupply the Drakes<br>Resupply the Strong Reeds<br>Resupply the Fire of the South<br><br>''Approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies.''</ic>

===Overview===
* Resupply the [[The Brass Coast|Freeborn]] army of the [[Brass_Coast_military_concerns#The Red Wind Corsairs|Red Wind Corsairs]].
* Resupply the [[The Brass Coast|Freeborn]] army of the [[Brass_Coast_military_concerns#The Fire of the South|Fire of the South]].
* Resupply the [[The Marches|Marcher]] army of the [[The_Marches_military_concerns#The Strong Reeds|Strong Reeds]].
* Resupply the [[The Marches|Marcher]] army of the [[The_Marches_military_concerns#The Drakes|Drakes]].
* The actions are grouped together, but each would count as a separate announcement for purposes of the [[Synod]] [[veto]].
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General using the legal power to resupply armies granted by the [[Senate]].

===Date===
* Summer Solstice 378YE

===Progress===
* 112 wains of Mithril and Weirwood provided by Janusz Dalibor von Temeschwar, Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies, after Summer Solstice 378YE
** 49 wains for the Red Wind Corsairs
** 43 wains for the Strong Reeds
** 20 wains for the Drakes
** 0 wains for the Fire of the South (this army is engaged by [[Thule]] forces in [[Sermersuaq]])

===Campaign Outcome===
* [[Casualties#Emergency_Resupply|Resupply]] an army using 49 wains restores fighting strength equal to 980 soldiers to the army.
* Resupply an army using 43 wains restored fighting strength equal to 860 soldiers to the army.
* Resupply an army using 20 wains restored fighting strength equal to 400 soldiers to the army.
